name: save-boot-14c-choice-mktinn-right-down
description: #168 attempt 3 (acceptance try, one of three walk directions). Boot harness/saves/disc1-mktinn.json (Wall Market's inn, field 0xC7; attempt 1: models 1-3 lie at +PosX, -PosY from the player) and load as save-boot-1-load does. Phase 1: walk right + down while pressing Circle (direction + Circle held 7 of every 8 frames, so Circle gives an edge every 8 frames while the player walks and faces the way it goes) until window 0 leaves state 0 (win_wait: any message or ask opened by a talk; timeout 600). Phase 2: press Circle (hold 2) every 30 frames until window 0's pointerEnabled reads 1 (ptr_wait: an ask shows its pointer; timeout 1800). Then mark, Down (4 frames, one edge: one line, pointerY = line * 16 + 6) and 12 frames, mark, Up (4) and 12: window 0 is still in state 6 (still6, a 1-frame wait); Circle (4) picks the first option and closes window 0 (close_wait: back to 0, timeout 300). pointerY is written only while an ask waits, so its end value is the one after Up: lower than after Down (up_dir -1: Up moved it, so Down had raised it) and equal to where the pointer appeared (back_dir 0). A rerun from the same snapshot matches (match). Each wait reports its own metric and later steps are skipped on a timeout, so the first zero says how far it got. Only frame counts and signs leave.
